title: Nourishment and Learning Equity for Schoolchildren
summary: Enhance daily nutrition and digital learning for schoolchildren, ensuring holistic growth and improved academic outcomes.
description:
In partnership with Saraswati Shishu Vidya Mandir, Bulandshahr, Saksham Trust has introduced a structured nutrition routine by providing milk and fruits alongside the establishment of a fully equipped digital classroom, with the objective of enhancing both health and learning outcomes for schoolchildren.

This integrated approach has led to noticeable improvements in attentiveness, classroom participation, and attendance, while also reflecting positively in academic results where children’s average marks have risen and weight gains have been recorded, indicating better overall well-being. By ensuring that every child receives nutritious food, the foundation for a healthy mind and a brighter future is being laid, where learning is not just possible but joyful.

Teachers and parents alike report higher motivation and readiness for learning among students, demonstrating the value of combining nutrition assurance with modern teaching methods. The initiative aligns strongly with the Government of India’s POSHAN Abhiyaan objectives and complements the Digital India vision for modern, inclusive education at the school level.
